fleet.clear_confirm: Clear this airline's fleet list? Your spots are not affected.
stats.no_gear_text: Gear statistics are built from your photos' metadata.

loc.no_window: No window with the sun behind you on that day.
loc.pick_hint: Tap the map or drag the marker to place the spot.
loc.name: Name
radar.heading: Heading
radar.about: ADS-B data provided by OpenSky Network (refreshed every 12 s). Without an account the quota is limited: add an OpenSky API client in settings. When it runs out, the radar automatically switches to adsb.lol / airplanes.live (free).
watch.sub: Get alerted when a tracked aircraft is detected airborne.
watch.empty_text: Add the registrations you're hunting (rare liveries, new aircraft…).
watch.confirm_remove: Remove this aircraft from the watchlist?
watch.perm_hint: Allow browser notifications to be alerted even when the tab is in the background.
watch.about: Checked every {n} min via OpenSky (and AirLabs when a key is configured, for departure and arrival airports). If the destination is one of your home airports, the alert says so.
story.sub: Create a summary image to share.
story.title: Title
story.share_unsupported: File sharing is not supported by this browser.
share.title: Share
share.privacy: Only the chosen items are visible. Personal notes and exact GPS coordinates are never published (only the airport).
share.sub: Read-only public links, revocable at any time.
share.empty_text: Share a gallery, an airframe or your flights from each page's menu.
share.revoke_confirm: Revoke this link? People who have it will no longer be able to access it.
share.base_hint: Links use the public address set in Settings › Integrations (otherwise the current address).
share.not_found: This link doesn't exist or has been revoked.
share.public_footer: Shared with Contrail — self-hosted spotting logbook.
notif.title: Notifications
search.title: Search
search.hint: Type at least 2 characters. <kbd>↑</kbd> <kbd>↓</kbd> to navigate, <kbd>Enter</kbd> to open.
drafts.saved: Offline: spot saved as a draft, it will sync when the network is back.
drafts.sub: Spots created without network, stored on this device.
drafts.hint: Sync happens automatically when the connection returns. Aircraft data, weather and badges are filled in at that point.
drafts.empty_text: Without network, your new spots are kept here and sent automatically.
tags.name: Tag name
tags.confirm_delete: Delete this tag? It will be removed from all spots.
settings.dashboard_hint: Widgets are chosen and reordered from the home page.
settings.modules_hint: Hide the features you don't need to keep the interface clean.
module.weather_d: Historical METAR/TAF attached to each spot
module.watchlist_d: Alerts when a tracked aircraft takes off
settings.home_airports_hint: Used by the radar and watchlist alerts (comma separated).
settings.keep_originals_d: Also keeps the original file in data/originals (uses more space).
settings.share_notes_d: Off by default to protect your privacy.
settings.i_aircraft_d: hexdb.io works without a key. Free AirLabs and Aviationstack keys complete the data (MSN, fleets).
settings.opensky_d: Optional: a (free) OpenSky API client greatly increases the radar and watchlist quota.
settings.i_notify_d: Relay alerts (watchlist, cross-references, achievements) to ntfy or a webhook to get them on your phone.
settings.public_url_hint: e.g. https://contrail.mydomain.com — used for share links and notifications.
settings.ocr_missing: Tesseract not found on the server
settings.backups_d: A .zip archive of the database and configuration, stored in data/backups and downloadable in one click.
settings.restore_confirm: Restoring this archive will replace the current database. A safety backup is created automatically just before. Continue?
settings.import_d: CSV files from JetPhotos, Planespotters, myFlightradar24, OpenFlights or a spreadsheet: columns are recognised automatically.
settings.export_d: The JSON contains every table. To migrate everything (photos included), simply copy the data/ folder or use the full archive.
import.hint_spots: Recognised columns: registration, type, airline, airport (code or name), date, time, MSN, livery, notes, tags…
import.hint_flights: Compatible with the myFlightradar24 export and generic CSVs (date, from, to, flight number, airline, aircraft, seat…).
import.enrich_d: Looks up missing data (type, airline, MSN) in the background.
about.tagline: Self-hosted plane spotting and flight logbook.
about.maintenance: This software is primarily developed for personal use. It is publicly available (open source), but the author makes no commitment to provide ongoing maintenance, bug fixes or long-term technical support.
about.credits_text: Maps © OpenStreetMap contributors. Flight and aircraft data come from free third-party services, subject to their own terms.
err.airports_required: Departure and arrival airports are required.
err.audio_too_large: Audio file too large (25 MB max).
err.airlabs_key_required: An AirLabs key is required (Settings › Integrations).
test.title: Test session
test.banner_text: sample data, your real data is neither read nor modified.
test.reset_confirm: Discard every change made in the test session and reload the original dataset?
test.desc: Explore Contrail with a sample dataset (62 spots without photos, 14 flights, fleets, spotting spots, weather). The test session uses a separate database: your real data stays untouched.
test.desc_in: You are in the test session. Everything you create here stays isolated in data/sandbox and can be wiped in one click.
settings.tiles_auto: Automatic — Positron or Dark following the theme
settings.map_hint: MapLibre GL vector maps with OpenFreeMap's free, key-less base maps (OpenStreetMap data). The custom style accepts any MapLibre style URL, e.g. a self-hosted tile server.
err.not_in_test_session: Only available in the test session.
radar.shapes_hint: The silhouette depends on the aircraft type: local reference database (Settings › Integrations), cache, then the ADS-B category broadcast by the aircraft.
refdb.title: Aircraft reference database
refdb.desc: Offline aircraft database (Mode-S, registration, type, operator). It improves the radar (silhouettes by type) and autofill, and builds complete fleets without AirLabs. Both sources add up.
refdb.credits: Data: Mictronics database via tar1090-db (GitHub) and the OpenSky Network aircraft database. Manual import accepted: tar1090/readsb CSV (";") or the OpenSky database with header, optionally .gz.
err.refdb_empty: No aircraft recognised in this file.
err.refdb_bad_download: The download did not return a valid database.
err.refdb_missing: Install the reference database first (Settings › Integrations).
fleet.refdb_hint: {n} aircraft from the local database seem to belong to this airline but are not in the fleet.
fleet.exclude_hint: Tap an aircraft to open it or exclude it from the fleet (retired, wrong source data…).
fleet.fetch_hint: The fleet is fetched page by page from AirLabs (50 aircraft per request with a free key, i.e. a few requests from your monthly quota).
fleet.include_light_d: Sources sometimes attach flying-club aircraft to an airline.
fleet.fetched_detail: {n} aircraft kept out of {r} received ({s} skipped: light aircraft)

spot.test_registration_hint: Temporary registration worn before delivery (e.g. F-WWxx), to link the aircraft to its future final registration. Leave empty if unknown.
storage.title: Storage
storage.refdb_hint: The aircraft reference database takes up most of the space; it can be deleted and downloaded again at any time.
storage.purge_confirm: Permanently delete {n} files that are not attached to any spot?
storage.corrupt: The database failed its integrity check: nothing was changed. Restore a backup.
airframe.aliases_hint: Grouped automatically by MSN (same manufacturer) and by test registration.
spot.photo_dup: This photo looks like {n} photo(s) you already saved.
backup.remote_desc: Every backup is also copied to a mounted folder (NAS, external drive, Syncthing) and/or a WebDAV server (Nextcloud, Synology). Without it, a disk failure takes the database, the photos and the backups together.
backup.remote_path_hint: Path as seen by the app (in Docker: a mounted volume). The folder must already exist.
backup.remote_waiting: Configured, waiting for the next backup
backup.remote_ok: Destination reachable: a test file was written then deleted.
spot.unknown_reg_hint: Unidentified aircraft: complete it later by editing the spot.
spot.place_ph: KJFK, Paris… or a city, a beach, an airshow
patrol.title: Formation
patrol.name: Formation name
patrol.hint: Each aircraft becomes a spot of its own (counted in the stats) with the same photo, date and place. Tick “Unknown” for an aircraft in the photo you could not identify; you can fill it in later.
patrol.leave: Remove this aircraft from the formation
settings.patrol_mode_hint: Simple: a formation is a single spot named after the team (it replaces the registration). Detailed: one spot per aircraft, sharing the photo, to track each registration.
patrol.simple_toggle: This photo is a formation (a single spot)
patrol.simple_hint: The formation name replaces the registration: it counts as a single aircraft, and its appearances accumulate under that name.
spots.scope_hint: When you open the list, only spots from the chosen airport or place are shown. Spots with no airport or place only appear under “All places”.
